instructions:
1. Lie on your side with an exercise ball under your armpit and lower ribs.
2. Extend your top leg straight and bend your lower leg, foot flat on the floor for stability.
3. Extend your top arm along the line of your body and let your bottom arm rest over the ball.
4. Relax your torso over the ball until you feel a stretch along your side and lats.
5. Hold, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Breathe deeply and let your ribs sink over the ball as you relax.
2. Only stretch as far as is comfortable, no straining.
3. Keep your bottom hip and foot planted for stability.
4. Avoid arching your lower back.

instructions:
1. Lie on your side with an exercise ball under your armpit and lower ribs.
2. Extend your top leg straight and bend your lower leg, foot flat on the floor for stability.
3. Let your bottom arm rest over the ball and reach your top arm overhead along your body.
4. Relax your torso over the ball until you feel a stretch along your side and lats.
5. Hold, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Breathe deeply and let your ribs sink over the ball as you relax.
2. Reach the overhead arm to deepen the stretch through the lat.
3. Keep your bottom hip and foot planted for stability.
4. Avoid arching your lower back.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms at your sides, palms down.
2. Place your left heel and calf on top of an exercise ball, with your right leg extended in line with your hips.
3. Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from shoulders to left heel.
4. Bend your left knee to roll the ball diagonally toward your hips while raising your right leg up.
5. Extend your left leg to roll the ball back and lower your right leg, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control through each phase.
2. Exhale as you curl the ball in, inhale as you extend.
3. Keep your hips level and lifted to load the hamstrings.
4. Use a firmly inflated ball for stability.

instructions:
1. Sit on an exercise ball with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, back straight.
2. Extend your right leg in front of you, heel on the floor, toes pointing up.
3. Hinge at your hips and lean forward with a straight back, reaching toward your right toes.
4. Feel the stretch along the back of your right thigh.
5. Hold, breathing steadily, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge from the hips, not by rounding your back.
2. Exhale as you lean forward into the stretch.
3. Only stretch as far as is comfortable.
4. Use a firmly inflated ball for support.

instructions:
1. Sit on an exercise ball with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Roll forward until your upper back rests on the ball, shoulders and head relaxed, arms out for balance.
3. Bend your left leg with the foot flat on the floor for support.
4. Bend your right leg, placing the forefoot on the floor and the heel back, to stretch the front of the right thigh.
5. Hold, breathing steadily, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Tuck your tailbone and push your hips up to deepen the stretch.
2. Exhale as you sink into the stretch.
3. Only stretch as far as is comfortable.
4. Use a firmly inflated ball for support.
